  • Field Details

    • studentId

      public Long studentId
      The ID of the student. This field uniquely identifies each student in the system, allowing us to associate courses with the correct student.

    • firstName

      public String firstName
      The first name of the student. This field is used to provide a human-readable name for the student, which can be displayed in the UI or reports.

    • lastName

      public String lastName
      The last name of the student. This field is used to provide a human-readable name for the student, which can be displayed in the UI or reports.

    • courses

      public List<SimpleCourse> courses
      The list of courses taken by the student. This field contains the courses that the student is enrolled in, allowing us to see which courses are associated with each student.
